newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria lev falls to 257.00/50 to dlr at close.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria lev falls to 257.00/50 to dlr at close.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev weakened to 257.00/50 per dollar at the close of the interbank forex market from 255.50-256.50 in the morning because foreign currency demand heavily outweighed supply, dealers said.
"A commercial bank in Sofia was bidding for relatively large dollar volumes since the opening, probably on behalf of a big final client," a commercial bank dealer said.
The dealer declined to identify the bank.
Foreign currency supply from commercial banks was low and the central bank sold dollars between 255 levs in the morning and 257 at the close to cushion the lev fall, dealers said.
Central bank officials were not immediately available for comment.
